# Strata Files

> Strata is a free, open-source (MIT) file manager for macOS, built natively in Swift and AppKit. It indexes your home folder for instant search (by name, with filters, or in plain English), shows live folder sizes and a disk-usage map, and offers macOS Quick Look, a command palette, dual pane, a copy queue with conflict previews, undoable history, Finder tags, archives you can browse like folders, batch rename, a project inspector and on-device document summaries, in 22 languages. Everything runs on the Mac: no accounts, no tracking, no servers.

- Website: https://stratafiles.app
- Download: https://github.com/cristipufu/strata-files/releases/latest (Strata.dmg, signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple)
- Requirements: macOS 26 Tahoe on a Mac with Apple silicon. Apple Intelligence is optional.
- Price: free. License: MIT.
- Appearance: native macOS colors with System, Light and Dark modes in Settings ▸ Appearance.
- Quick Look: press Space to open the macOS Quick Look panel for the selected items. The inspector offers additional format-specific previews.
- Read EPUB chapters offline in the inspector and browse CBZ, CBR, CB7 and CBT comic archives. Search with `kind:book`, `kind:ebook` or `kind:comic`. MOBI, AZW3 and DjVu are searchable by kind.
